from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full solid lines are panel dividers.
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep = grid[row_seps[0]][0] if row_seps else grid[0][col_seps[0]]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    # The most common non-divider color is the panel background.
    cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in row_seps
             for c in range(w) if c not in col_seps]
    bg = Counter(cells).most_common(1)[0][0]
    src = None
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            tile = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            if any(x != bg for row in tile for x in row):
                src = tile
                break
        if src is not None:
            break
    out = [[sep if r in row_seps or c in col_seps else bg for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            for rr in range(r0, r1):
                for cc in range(c0, c1):
                    out[rr][cc] = src[(rr-r0) % len(src)][(cc-c0) % len(src[0])]
    return out
